C-01.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd frontend
node --import tsx --test tests/scanner-lifecycle.test.ts tests/scan-flow.test.ts tests/bottom-nav-regression.test.ts
npm run typecheck

C-04.obligation: On a physical supported mobile device and camera-capable browser, observe camera release and three flower scan/close/reopen/second-capture cycles; repeat close during capture/analysis, after failure, via results Back, and permission recovery. Record platforms and any unverified cases; mocks cannot prove camera release.

C-05.obligation: Save before/after screenshots with scenario, platform, viewport and observed result for fresh preview after reentry, no stale photo/report/spinner/error, and permission/mount-error recovery; confirm existing layout is preserved. Screenshots alone do not prove camera release.

C-06.note: Candidate-wide release gate; missing generated backend client was a pre-existing baseline prerequisite, never a waived failure.
